RENEWABLE ENERGY SOLUTIONS

Design, Installation & Maintenance of Photovoltaic (Solar) Systems

Turnkey industrial solar integration tailored for heavy commercial facilities, mines, and processing plants. We optimize energy yields, reduce grid reliance, and ensure seamless synchronization with existing substation and switchgear infrastructure.

Engineering-Grade Industrial Solar Energy

At Uncut Electro Mechanical Engineering, we treat solar photovoltaic systems not as standalone commercial add-ons, but as core components of your plant’s overall high-voltage power distribution ecosystem.

Whether operating grid-tied to offset heavy peak-demand charges or integrated into hybrid microgrids alongside industrial diesel generators, our systems are designed to deliver reliable power under strict industrial operating conditions.

📐

1. Custom System Design

Precision load profiling and structural array engineering.

  • Load Curve & Maximum Demand Analysis: Tailoring system capacity directly to your plant's operational duty cycle.
  • Structural & Roof Load Audits: Full ballast, ballast mount, and structural integrity evaluations prior to layout approval.
  • Grid-Tie & Hybrid Synchronization: Designing automatic generator changeover and reverse-power protection schemes.
  • Inverter & Array String Matching: Optimizing string voltage calculations for maximum MPPT efficiency across seasonal thermal ranges.
⚡

2. Turnkey Installation

Standards-compliant mechanical & electrical execution.

  • Substation & Switchgear Integration: Direct LV/MV tie-ins with dedicated circuit breaker protection panels.
  • Tier-1 PV Module Mounts: Heavy-duty, corrosion-resistant racking designed for industrial roof profiles and ground mounts.
  • Cabling & Conduit Management: UV-resistant DC cabling, underground trenching, and armored cable runs complying with SANS code.
  • Compliance & Certification: Complete grid-connection documentation, CoC issuance, and protection relay testing.
🛠️

3. Lifetime Maintenance

Predictive asset care to guarantee continuous peak output.

  • Thermographic Array Audits: Infrared imaging to detect hot spots, failed bypass diodes, or micro-cracks before output drops.
  • Inverter Health & Cleaning: Heat sink dust removal, fan servicing, and firmware updates for central inverter banks.
  • String Voltage & Megger Testing: Insulation resistance testing to verify cable integrity and locate ground faults.
  • Array Washing Protocols: Scheduled panel cleaning schedules tailored for dusty industrial environments.

Need Generator & Solar Co-Generation?

We specialize in complex retrofits where solar PV works side-by-side with emergency diesel generators. Our control logic prevents reverse power feeding into generators during low-load/high-solar conditions, protecting your backup units from damage.
